title: Chivu speaks Friday as the press expects changes
description: Daniele Doveri will referee Saturday’s match at the Dall’Ara, and Gazzetta dello Sport and Corriere dello Sport both expect Cristian Chivu to rest players who started against Parma and Club Brugge.
mast_alt: Nerazzurri Daily Edition No. 44, Thursday, October 15, 2026 — Chivu speaks Friday as the press expects changes

blocks.html: Cristian Chivu, Inter’s head coach, faces reporters on Friday at 8:30 AM ET, 14:30 CEST, at Appiano Gentile, Inter’s training ground. Inter play at Bologna the next day. Daniele Doveri will referee it: the Lega Serie A named him on Wednesday. Gazzetta dello Sport, Italy’s biggest sports daily, and Corriere dello Sport both expect Chivu to change his lineup.

blocks.h3: Chivu speaks on Friday, and Doveri will referee at Bologna
paras: Inter have set Cristian Chivu’s pre-match press conference for Friday. It begins at 8:30 AM ET, 14:30 CEST, at the training center at Appiano Gentile, and the club will stream it.

The match is Saturday at 12:00 PM ET, 18:00 CEST, at the Dall’Ara in Bologna. It is matchday 7 of Serie A. The Lega Serie A named Daniele Doveri as the referee on Wednesday. Italy gets the match on DAZN; US listings show Paramount+, CBS Sports Golazo and Peacock.

blocks.h3: Inter U23 host Monopoli on Saturday
paras: Inter’s U23 team play Monopoli on Saturday at 8:30 AM ET, 14:30 CEST. The stadium is the Ernesto Breda in Sesto San Giovanni, and it is matchday 10 of Serie C.
Inter U23, coached by Stefano Vecchi, are seventh with 13 points from eight matches and have a match in hand. Monopoli are 12th with 12 points. Inter won 4–0 at Giugliano on Tuesday.

blocks.h3: Inter Women host Parma on Sunday
paras: Inter Women play Parma on Sunday at 10:00 AM ET, 16:00 CEST. The venue is the Arena Civica Gianni Brera in Milan, and it is matchday 3 of Serie A Women.

Inter have won both league matches and have six points. The last was a 2–0 win at Como Women on October 4. Karolina Lea Vilhjálmsdóttir, the midfielder, scored a penalty in the 63rd minute, and Haley Bugeja, the forward, added the second in the 83rd.

blocks.h3: The papers expect Chivu to change his lineup at Bologna
paras: Gazzetta dello Sport reported on Thursday that Carlos Augusto, the left-sided defender, is in line to start. He missed the Club Brugge match with a physical problem. The paper also puts Benjamin Pavard, the center-back, back in the defense, and has Ange-Yoan Bonny, the forward, close to a start.

Corriere dello Sport wrote that Yann Bisseck, the defender, Hakan Çalhanoğlu, the midfielder, and Marcus Thuram, the forward, all started against both Parma and Club Brugge. All three could sit, with Andy Diouf and Federico Dimarco. John Stones, the defender, and Curtis Jones, the midfielder, are still injured.
blocks.kicker: GAZZETTA DELLO SPORT AND CORRIERE DELLO SPORT VIA FCINTERNEWS · OCT 15

blocks.h3: Sportitalia: Mancuso close to a new deal to 2031
paras: Sportitalia reported on Wednesday that Inter are close to extending Matias Mancuso’s contract to 2031. He is a teenage midfielder in the U23 squad and started the win at Giugliano. FCInterNews relayed the report and credited the journalist Gianluigi Longari.
